commit_proposal.subject: Evaluate Coralai occupancy alongside image–text alignment
commit_proposal.body:
Add the six-run issue #25 occupancy analysis and classroom assets. Preserve
historical log timing: six exact endpoint matches and 114 scored frames without
same-update population measurements.

Add a separate seed-303 paired pilot pinned to simulator c782434f, with 40
synchronized image/checkpoint pairs and fresh CLIP/SigLIP scores. Default
occupancy decreases as both scores rise; selected occupancy increases while
CLIP decreases. Keep model scales separate and limit findings to these runs.

Reject incomplete recording-manifest coverage and add a regression test for a
truncated manifest. Validate 23 focused tests, 120 historical score inputs,
52 checkpoint recounts, 40 aligned rendering matches, and both 10-second GIFs.
Occupancy does not measure organisms or reproductive viability; no causal or
across-seed inference is made from the pilot.

remaining_concerns: Reproduction uses an isolated /tmp environment, source checkout, and model cache; reproduce.txt documents rebuilding these after cleanup.
The 40 simulation resume pickles contribute about 8.3 MB and are required by the current verifier. Removing them is a separate payload/verification choice.
Historical interpretation text and layouts are intentionally specific to this fixed six-run study; do not treat the script as a general study-report generator.
Older review.json test counts and dependency limitations describe the original executions; this audit records the current focused results separately.
